name: null_regions_grid
description: Percentile-grid form of null_regions (docs/specs/M9-17-plot-support-analysis.md, lead decisions 2 and 8), written by the context_stats step when the exhaustive null_regions file reaches 5 MB (2^20 bytes per MB). Per tested (region, contig, stat): the 1st-99th (numpy linear) percentiles of the null's finite values (±inf and NaN dropped first); a null of K <= 99 finite values keeps its exact values ascending, ranked 1..K; an all-NaN null gives NA null_value rows. In this form p cannot be recomputed from the file; regions_stats p_value and n_perm are authoritative. Not a result table.

fields.name: contig
fields.description: Replicon the region was tested on (a region split across contigs has one null per contig)

fields.name: stat
fields.description: Test statistic of the region test

fields.name: percentile
fields.description: Percentile 1-99 of the null; for a null of at most 99 finite values, the 1-based rank of the exact value instead

fields.name: null_value
fields.description: The null's studentised statistic at this percentile (or rank); NA when the null has no finite value

fields.name: observed
fields.description: The observed studentised statistic the null is compared with
